AI website builder FAQs

Read answers to frequently asked questions about our AI website generator.

What is an AI website builder?

An AI website builder is a platform that uses artificial intelligence to generate a custom website from scratch – no coding or technical knowledge required.

You have two ways to build with AI. The first is Manual mode, which combines AI generation with drag-and-drop editing: describe your website in a single prompt, get a ready-made site instantly, and fine-tune it visually from there. It's the fastest way to go from idea to a polished, professional site.

The second is Agentic mode, also known as vibe coding – a fully conversational experience where both building and customizing happen through a chat with AI. Because the AI generates design elements uniquely for you, the creative possibilities are unlimited.

Both approaches are beginner-friendly and can have your site up and running in minutes – whether you're building a portfolio, blog, online store, or booking site.

What is vibe coding?

Vibe coding is a way of building online projects by having a conversation with AI in plain language – no coding or technical knowledge required. Instead of manually designing layouts or writing code, you simply prompt the AI with what you want, and it builds it for you, refining and adjusting as you chat.

This experience is called Agentic mode – one of the AI-powered building experiences included in every AI website builder plan. It's the default option for more complex projects – think large ecommerce stores with user accounts, membership and subscription sites, learning platforms, portals, reservation systems, and other interactive web experiences – as it gives you the flexibility to bring more ambitious ideas to life. Every design is generated uniquely based on your prompts, giving you unlimited creative freedom without touching a single line of code. Each plan comes with a set amount of prompting credits – and if you need more, topping up is quick and easy.

How to choose the best AI website builder?

The best AI website maker for you depends on your goals, technical comfort, and the type of project you want to create. Here are the key factors to consider:

  • Ease of use. Look for a builder that requires no coding or technical knowledge. The best AI website builders let you describe your idea in plain language and generate a ready-made site instantly – no steep learning curve required.
  • Customization options. Consider how much control you want over the final result. Some builders combine AI generation with drag-and-drop editing for quick, visual customization. Others, like vibe coding builders, let you shape every detail through conversation with AI for virtually unlimited creative freedom.
  • Type of project. Make sure the builder supports what you want to create – whether that's a portfolio, blog, online store, booking site, or a fully interactive web application.
  • Built-in features. The best builders include everything you need in one place: hosting, a domain, SSL certificates, SEO tools, and support – without hidden fees or the need to piece together multiple services.
  • Performance and SEO. Your site should load fast, be mobile-friendly, and be discoverable by search engines from day one – without any manual setup on your part.
  • Support. Reliable 24/7 support ensures you're never stuck, especially if you're building your first website.
